_meta.title: Map Genie · Subnautica: Below Zero
_meta.note: tilesBaseUrl defaults to Map Genie CDN so the bathymetry shows without mirroring; set to /tiles/mapgenie/ after npm run download:mapgenie-bz-tiles for offline. Biome colors come from mapGenieRegionStylesById.json (extracted from mapData.styles.regionStyles). Main raster uses MapLibre defaults (no mainRasterPaint) so JPEG tiles match mapgenie.io.

regionPolygonOverlay.note: Cave-sheet polygons share world mapData but use a different tile sheet; hide fill/line/labels for these titles on the world raster (opacity 0 + label filter).
